text: Research Institute of Economics and Management (RIEM) at SWUFE was established in 2006 among China’s other four pioneers in the promotion of modern economics and business education. RIEM dedicated to high-quality teaching and research in economics, finance, and management. RIEM enjoys a national and international reputation for its high-quality academic programs and research.With a steadfast mission, RIEM has been dedicated to cultivating future leaders with devotion to family and country social responsibility, innovative spirit, and global vision. The institute offers a suite of first-class full-time degree programs including BSc, MSc, MA, and Ph.D as options for study. Our curriculum is internationalized and exclusively taught in English, which few Chinese institutions possess. All faculty members were internationally educated and received doctoral degrees from prestigious universities or institutions around the world.
